'''Nub Shanda''' was a [[lake]] on the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon]] of [[Endor (planet)/Legends|Endor]]. It was located in the [[Mertuen Forest]], west of the [[Moon/Legends|moon's]] [[Research Outpost]].<ref name="SWG" /> The [[Ewok Lake Village (north)|stilt village]] of the [[Gondula]] tribe was built on the lake.<ref name="SWG:ELV" />

{{Nature-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Nub Shanda appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>
